correctness.rationale: For iid Exp(1) and Z∞=sup_{n>=1} (X1+...+Xn)/n, source supplies exact inverse CDF F^-1(u)=-log(1-u)/u on u in (0,1). Transform U=1-e^-E, E~Exp(1), gives Z=E/(1-e^-E). Set q=1-F(x); x(q)=-log(q)/(1-q), dx/dq=-(1-q+q log q)/(q(1-q)^2). Therefore hazard=(1-q)^2/(1-q+q log q). Differentiating gives dh/dq>0 because φ(L)=L-2+e^-L(L+2)>0 for L>0, φ(0)=0, φ′=1-e^-L(L+1)>0. Since q decreases with x, hazard strictly falls from 2 to1 on x>1. Positive binomial expansion and monotone convergence prove integer m>=1 moments m!Σ_{n>=1} binom(m+n-2,m-1)/n^(m+1), mean ζ(2), second moment 2ζ(2), exact variance π²(12-π²)/36.
